description: Computes a paid-time-off balance in days at an as-of date: months worked this year (hire month counts in full), years of service (days / 365), effective rate after tenure tiers (tier 2 replaces tier 1), accrued days capped at the annual cap (monthly accrual or annual front-loaded grant prorated in the hire year), carryover capped at the policy maximum, approved leave taken (Monday-Friday workdays minus holidays, half days) and pending leave. left = carryover + accrued - taken, may be negative. No rounding. Year boundary: accrual restarts on January 1; the carryover is the value you enter.

carryover.description: Carryover entered from the previous year, in days, before the policy cap.

annual_cap.description: Cap on accrued days, applied before carryover is added.

carryover_max.description: Cap on the carryover entered for the employee.

period.description: monthly: rate days earned per calendar month worked; annual: rate days granted up front each year.

rate.description: Days per month (monthly) or per year (annual).

tier1_bonus.description: Added to rate once tier 1 is reached.

tier1_years.description: Tenure threshold of tier 1 in years (0 disables it).

tier2_bonus.description: Added to rate once tier 2 is reached.

tier2_years.description: Tenure threshold of tier 2 in years (0 disables it); replaces tier 1.

requests.description: Leave requests. Only approved ones are deducted.

end_half.description: Last day is a half day.

start_half.description: First day is a half day.

us_federal_holidays_years.description: Also treat the 11 U.S. federal holidays (observed dates) of these years as non-working.

name: pto_accrual
title: PTO balance (accrual, tiers, cap, carryover)
